import math

real64 as_real(int value)
    result := real64(value)
    return result

real64 root(real64 value)
    result := math.sqrt(value)
    return result

real64 logarithm(real64 value)
    result := math.log(value)
    return result

real64 absolute(real64 value)
    return if value < 0.0 then -value else value

real64 clip(real64 value)
    return if value < 1.0 then 1.0 elif value > 5.0 then 5.0 else value

real64 rmse(real64[] errors)
    real64 sum := 0.0
    for value := errors[]
        sum += value * value
    return root(sum / as_real(int(#errors)))

real64 mae(real64[] errors)
    real64 sum := 0.0
    for value := errors[]
        sum += absolute(value)
    return sum / as_real(int(#errors))

real64 rank_weight(int rank)
    return 1.0 / (logarithm(as_real(rank + 1)) / logarithm(2.0))

class Ranking(int hits, real64 recall, real64 ndcg, real64 ap, real64 rr)

Ranking ranking(int[] list, bool[] relevant, int relevant_count, int count)
    hits := 0
    real64 dcg := 0.0
    real64 ap := 0.0
    real64 reciprocal := 0.0
    for: index < count
        rank := index + 1
        if relevant[list[index]]
            hits += 1
            dcg += rank_weight(rank)
            ap += as_real(hits) / as_real(rank)
            if reciprocal == 0.0
                reciprocal = 1.0 / as_real(rank)
    denominator := if count < relevant_count then count else relevant_count
    real64 ideal := 0.0
    for: 1 <= rank <= denominator
        ideal += rank_weight(rank)
    return Ranking(hits, as_real(hits) / as_real(relevant_count), dcg / ideal, ap / as_real(denominator), reciprocal)

public import ratings = "./ratings.qui"
import evaluation = "./evaluation.qui"

real64[] zeros(int size)
    return [for index := (0:<size)[] then 0.0]

real64[][] square(int size)
    return [for index := (0:<size)[] then zeros(size)]

class Generator(int state)
    int .draw()
        state = 48271 * state % 2147483647
        return state

class Model(real64[][] users, real64[][] items, real64[] user_bias, real64[] item_bias, real64[] log)

real64 initial(Generator &generator)
    value := .generator.draw()
    return evaluation.as_real(value % 2001 - 1000) / 10000.0

real64[][] factors(Generator &generator, int rows, int count)
    real64[][] result := []
    for: row < rows
        real64[] values := []
        for: factor < count
            values = values.append(initial(&generator))
        result = result.append(values)
    return result

real64 dot(real64[] first, real64[] second)
    real64 result := 0.0
    for: index < int(#first)
        result += first[index] * second[index]
    return result

real64 training_rmse(int[][] training, real64 mean, real64[] user_bias, real64[] item_bias, real64[][] users, real64[][] items)
    real64 sum := 0.0
    for row := training[]
        predicted := ((mean + user_bias[row[0]]) + item_bias[row[1]]) + dot(users[row[0]], items[row[1]])
        difference := evaluation.as_real(row[2]) - predicted
        sum += difference * difference
    return evaluation.root(sum / evaluation.as_real(int(#training)))

Model svd(ratings.Data data)
    params := data.params
    generator := Generator(params.seed)
    users := factors(&generator, int(#data.users), params.factors)
    items := factors(&generator, int(#data.items), params.factors)
    user_bias := zeros(int(#data.users))
    item_bias := zeros(int(#data.items))
    real64[] log := []
    order := (0:<int(#data.training))
    for _ < params.epochs
        for: backwards < int(#order) - 1
            t := int(#order) - 1 - backwards
            value := .generator.draw()
            other := value % (t + 1)
            saved := order[t]
            order[t] = order[other]
            order[other] = saved
        for index := order[]
            row := data.training[index]
            u := row[0]
            i := row[1]
            predicted := ((data.mean + user_bias[u]) + item_bias[i]) + dot(users[u], items[i])
            difference := evaluation.as_real(row[2]) - predicted
            user_bias[u] += params.learning_rate * (difference - params.regularization * user_bias[u])
            item_bias[i] += params.learning_rate * (difference - params.regularization * item_bias[i])
            for: int f < params.factors
                a := users[u][f]
                b := items[i][f]
                users[u][f] = a + params.learning_rate * (difference * b - params.regularization * a)
                items[i][f] = b + params.learning_rate * (difference * a - params.regularization * b)
        log = log.append(training_rmse(data.training, data.mean, user_bias, item_bias, users, items))
    return Model(users, items, user_bias, item_bias, log)

real64[] solve(real64[][] a, real64[] w)
    size := int(#w)
    lower := square(size)
    for: row < size
        for: column <= row
            real64 sum := 0.0
            for: t < column
                sum += lower[row][t] * lower[column][t]
            value := a[row][column] - sum
            lower[row][column] = if row == column then evaluation.root(value) else value / lower[column][column]
    z := zeros(size)
    x := zeros(size)
    for: row < size
        real64 sum := 0.0
        for: t < row
            sum += lower[row][t] * z[t]
        z[row] = (w[row] - sum) / lower[row][row]
    for: backwards < size
        row := size - 1 - backwards
        real64 sum := 0.0
        for: row + 1 <= t < size
            sum += lower[t][row] * x[t]
        x[row] = (z[row] - sum) / lower[row][row]
    return x

Model als(ratings.Data data, real64[] user_bias, real64[] item_bias)
    params := data.params
    generator := Generator(params.seed)
    items := factors(&generator, int(#data.items), params.factors)
    users := [for u := data.users[] then zeros(params.factors)]
    real64[] log := []
    for _ < params.als_iterations
        for: u < int(#data.users)
            a := square(params.factors)
            w := zeros(params.factors)
            for i := data.user_ratings[u][]
                vector := items[i]
                z := evaluation.as_real(data.values[u][i]) - ((data.mean + user_bias[u]) + item_bias[i])
                for: int first < params.factors
                    w[first] += z * vector[first]
                    for: int second < params.factors
                        a[first][second] += vector[first] * vector[second]
            for: int first < params.factors
                a[first][first] += params.als_reg * evaluation.as_real(data.user_counts[u])
            users[u] = solve(a, w)
        for: i < int(#data.items)
            a := square(params.factors)
            w := zeros(params.factors)
            for u := data.item_ratings[i][]
                vector := users[u]
                z := evaluation.as_real(data.values[u][i]) - ((data.mean + user_bias[u]) + item_bias[i])
                for: int first < params.factors
                    w[first] += z * vector[first]
                    for: int second < params.factors
                        a[first][second] += vector[first] * vector[second]
            for: int first < params.factors
                a[first][first] += params.als_reg * evaluation.as_real(data.item_counts[i])
            items[i] = solve(a, w)
        log = log.append(training_rmse(data.training, data.mean, user_bias, item_bias, users, items))
    return Model(users, items, user_bias, item_bias, log)

import factorization = "./factorization.qui"
import neighborhood = "./neighborhood.qui"
import evaluation = "./evaluation.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

string[] methods()
    return ["GLOBAL", "BASELINE", "USER_KNN", "ITEM_KNN", "SLOPE_ONE", "SVD", "ALS"]

string[] rankings()
    return ["POPULAR", "BASELINE", "USER_KNN", "ITEM_KNN", "SLOPE_ONE", "SVD", "ALS"]

string real_text(real64 value, defined := true)
    return report.real_text(value, defined)

string integers(int[] values)
    fields := [for value := values[] then "{value}"]
    return fields.join(" ")

bool contains(int[] values, int value)
    for item := values[]
        if item == value
            return true
    return false

bool contains_name(string[] values, string value)
    for item := values[]
        if item == value
            return true
    return false

string title(factorization.ratings.Data data, int item)
    return data.catalog.titles[data.item_catalog[item]]

string[] genres(factorization.ratings.Data data, int item)
    return data.catalog.genres[data.item_catalog[item]]

real64 baseline_rmse(int[][] training, real64 mean, real64[] users, real64[] items)
    real64 sum := 0.0
    for row := training[]
        difference := evaluation.as_real(row[2]) - ((mean + users[row[0]]) + items[row[1]])
        sum += difference * difference
    return evaluation.root(sum / evaluation.as_real(int(#training)))

class Baseline(real64[] users, real64[] items, real64[] log)
class Prediction(real64 value, bool fallback, int count, real64 similarity, int top)
class RankedItem(int index, real64 value)

Baseline train_baseline(factorization.ratings.Data data)
    users := factorization.zeros(int(#data.users))
    items := factorization.zeros(int(#data.items))
    real64[] log := []
    for _ < 10
        for: i < int(#data.items)
            real64 sum := 0.0
            for u := data.item_ratings[i][]
                sum += evaluation.as_real(data.values[u][i]) - data.mean - users[u]
            items[i] = sum / (data.params.item_reg + evaluation.as_real(data.item_counts[i]))
        for: u < int(#data.users)
            real64 sum := 0.0
            for i := data.user_ratings[u][]
                sum += evaluation.as_real(data.values[u][i]) - data.mean - items[i]
            users[u] = sum / (data.params.user_reg + evaluation.as_real(data.user_counts[u]))
        log = log.append(baseline_rmse(data.training, data.mean, users, items))
    return Baseline(users, items, log)

int[][][] empty_lists(int users)
    int[][][] result := []
    for: u < users
        int[][] row := [[], [], [], [], [], [], []]
        result = result.append(row)
    return result

class Predictor(factorization.ratings.Data[] inputs, Baseline[] baselines, neighborhood.Result[] neighborhoods, factorization.Model[] svds, factorization.Model[] alss, int[] popularity)
    int[][][] lists := empty_lists(int(#inputs[0].users))
    bool[][] cached := [for u := inputs[0].users[] then [false, false, false, false, false, false, false]]

    real64 baseline(int u, int i)
        data := inputs[0]
        model := baselines[0]
        return (data.mean + model.users[u]) + model.items[i]

    Prediction predict(int method, int u, int i, requested_count := -1)
        data := inputs[0]
        factorization.ratings.Params params := data.params
        neighbors := neighborhoods[0]
        int count := if requested_count < 0 then params.k else requested_count
        real64 value := baseline(u, i)
        fallback := false
        used := 0
        real64 average_similarity := 0.0
        top := -1
        if method == 0
            value = data.mean
        elif method == 2 or method == 3
            neighborhood.Candidate[] candidates := []
            if method == 2
                for v := data.item_ratings[i][]
                    similarity := neighbors.users[u][v]
                    if similarity != 2.0 and similarity > params.threshold
                        candidates = candidates.append(neighborhood.Candidate(v, similarity, data.values[v][i]))
            else
                for j := data.user_ratings[u][]
                    similarity := neighbors.items[i][j]
                    if similarity != 2.0 and similarity > params.threshold
                        candidates = candidates.append(neighborhood.Candidate(j, similarity, data.values[u][j]))
            neighborhood.Candidate[] selected := neighborhood.select(candidates, count)
            if #selected == 0
                fallback = true
            else
                real64 numerator := 0.0
                real64 denominator := 0.0
                for candidate := selected[]
                    real64 mean := if method == 2 then data.user_means[candidate.index] else data.item_means[candidate.index]
                    numerator += candidate.similarity * (evaluation.as_real(candidate.rating) - mean)
                    denominator += candidate.similarity
                value = (if method == 2 then data.user_means[u] else data.item_means[i]) + numerator / denominator
                used = int(#selected)
                average_similarity = denominator / evaluation.as_real(used)
                top = selected[0].index
        elif method == 4
            real64 numerator := 0.0
            denominator := 0
            for j := data.user_ratings[u][]
                common := neighbors.common[i][j]
                if common >= 1
                    deviation := evaluation.as_real(neighbors.difference[i][j]) / evaluation.as_real(common + params.shrinkage)
                    numerator += (deviation + evaluation.as_real(data.values[u][j])) * evaluation.as_real(common)
                    denominator += common
            if denominator == 0
                fallback = true
            else
                value = numerator / evaluation.as_real(denominator)
        elif method == 5
            model := svds[0]
            value = ((data.mean + model.user_bias[u]) + model.item_bias[i]) + factorization.dot(model.users[u], model.items[i])
        elif method == 6
            model := alss[0]
            value = baseline(u, i) + factorization.dot(model.users[u], model.items[i])
        return Prediction(value, fallback, used, average_similarity, top)

    int[] .ranked(int method, int u)
        if cached[u][method]
            return lists[u][method]
        data := inputs[0]
        int[] items := []
        if method == 0
            for i := popularity[]
                if data.values[u][i] == 0
                    items = items.append(i)
        else
            RankedItem[] ordered := []
            for: i < int(#data.items)
                if data.values[u][i] != 0
                    continue
                Prediction prediction := predict(method, u, i)
                item := RankedItem(i, prediction.value)
                place := int(#ordered)
                for: position < int(#ordered)
                    if item.value > ordered[position].value
                        place = position
                        break
                ordered = ordered[0:<place].append(item).concat(ordered[place:<int(#ordered)])
            items = [for item := ordered[] then item.index]
        lists[u][method] = items
        cached[u][method] = true
        return items

Predictor build_predictor(factorization.ratings.Data data)
    baseline := train_baseline(data)
    svd := factorization.svd(data)
    als := factorization.als(data, baseline.users, baseline.items)
    int[] popularity := []
    for: i < int(#data.items)
        place := int(#popularity)
        for: position < int(#popularity)
            other := popularity[position]
            if data.item_counts[i] > data.item_counts[other] or (data.item_counts[i] == data.item_counts[other] and data.item_means[i] > data.item_means[other])
                place = position
                break
        popularity = popularity[0:<place].append(i).concat(popularity[place:<int(#popularity)])
    neighbors := neighborhood.build(data.values, data.user_ratings, data.item_ratings, data.user_means, data.params.shrinkage)
    return Predictor([data], [baseline], [neighbors], [svd], [als], popularity)

class Testing(string[] csv, Prediction[][] predictions, real64[][] clipped, real64[][] errors, bool[][] relevant, int[] relevant_counts, int[] evaluated)

Testing test_predictions(Predictor predictor)
    data := predictor.inputs[0]
    Prediction[][] predictions := [[], [], [], [], [], [], []]
    real64[][] clipped := [[], [], [], [], [], [], []]
    real64[][] errors := [[], [], [], [], [], [], []]
    csv := ["user,item,actual,GLOBAL,BASELINE,USER_KNN,ITEM_KNN,SLOPE_ONE,SVD,ALS"]
    for row := data.testing[]
        fields := ["{data.users[row[0]]}", "{data.items[row[1]]}", "{row[2]}"]
        for: method < 7
            prediction := predictor.predict(method, row[0], row[1])
            value := evaluation.clip(prediction.value)
            predictions[method] = predictions[method].append(prediction)
            clipped[method] = clipped[method].append(value)
            errors[method] = errors[method].append(value - evaluation.as_real(row[2]))
            fields = fields.append(real_text(value))
        csv = csv.append(fields.join(","))
    bool[][] relevant := []
    for: u < int(#data.users)
        relevant = relevant.append([for i := data.items[] then false])
    relevant_counts := [for u := data.users[] then 0]
    for row := data.testing[]
        if row[2] >= 4
            relevant[row[0]][row[1]] = true
            relevant_counts[row[0]] += 1
    int[] evaluated := []
    for: u < int(#data.users)
        if relevant_counts[u] > 0
            evaluated = evaluated.append(u)
    return Testing(csv, predictions, clipped, errors, relevant, relevant_counts, evaluated)

int group_number(int value, int[] bounds)
    result := 0
    for bound := bounds[]
        if value >= bound
            result += 1
    return result

string error_fields(real64[][] errors, int[] indices, bool absolute)
    names := methods()
    string[] fields := []
    for: method < 7
        selected := [for index := indices[] then errors[method][index]]
        real64 value := 0.0
        if #selected > 0
            value = if absolute then evaluation.mae(selected) else evaluation.rmse(selected)
        fields = fields.append(names[method] + " " + real_text(value, #selected > 0))
    return fields.join(" ")

real64 median(int[] values)
    ordered := values.sorted()
    count := int(#ordered)
    if count % 2 == 1
        return evaluation.as_real(ordered[count / 2])
    return evaluation.as_real(ordered[count / 2 - 1] + ordered[count / 2]) / 2.0

evaluation.Ranking ranked_metrics(Predictor predictor, Testing tested, int u, int method, int count)
    return evaluation.ranking(predictor.lists[u][method], tested.relevant[u], tested.relevant_counts[u], count)

int[] bias_order(real64[] biases, bool descending)
    int[] order := []
    for: index < int(#biases)
        place := int(#order)
        for: position < int(#order)
            other := order[position]
            if (descending and biases[index] > biases[other]) or (not descending and biases[index] < biases[other])
                place = position
                break
        order = order[0:<place].append(index).concat(order[place:<int(#order)])
    return order

string[] all_genres(factorization.ratings.Data data, int[] items)
    string[] result := []
    for item := items[]
        for genre := genres(data, item)[]
            if not contains_name(result, genre)
                result = result.append(genre)
    return result.sorted()

string[] evaluation_report(Predictor predictor, Testing tested)
    data := predictor.inputs[0]
    factorization.ratings.Params params := data.params
    neighbors := predictor.neighborhoods[0]
    baseline := predictor.baselines[0]
    svd := predictor.svds[0]
    als := predictor.alss[0]
    names := methods()
    ranking_names := rankings()
    string[][] sections := []
    histogram := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    int first_time := data.training[0][3]
    last_time := first_time
    for row := data.training[]
        histogram[row[2] - 1] += 1
        if row[3] < first_time
            first_time = row[3]
        if row[3] > last_time
            last_time = row[3]
    int[] user_counts := data.user_counts.sorted()
    int[] item_counts := data.item_counts.sorted()
    user_pairs := 0
    usable_users := 0
    item_pairs := 0
    usable_items := 0
    slope_pairs := 0
    for: u < int(#data.users) - 1
        for: u + 1 <= v < int(#data.users)
            similarity := neighbors.users[u][v]
            if similarity != 2.0
                user_pairs += 1
                if similarity > params.threshold
                    usable_users += 1
    for: i < int(#data.items) - 1
        for: i + 1 <= j < int(#data.items)
            similarity := neighbors.items[i][j]
            if similarity != 2.0
                item_pairs += 1
                if similarity > params.threshold
                    usable_items += 1
            if neighbors.common[i][j] >= 1
                slope_pairs += 1
    lines := [
        "data users {#data.users} items {#data.items} catalog {#data.catalog.ids} ratings {#data.training} test {#data.testing}",
        "density " + real_text(evaluation.as_real(int(#data.training)) / evaluation.as_real(int(#data.users) * int(#data.items))) + " global_mean " + real_text(data.mean),
        "histogram " + integers(histogram),
        "user_ratings min {user_counts[0]} median " + real_text(median(user_counts)) + " max {user_counts[-1]}",
        "item_ratings min {item_counts[0]} median " + real_text(median(item_counts)) + " max {item_counts[-1]}",
        "timestamps first {first_time} last {last_time}",
        "cold_items {int(#data.catalog.ids) - int(#data.items)}",
        "similarities user_pairs {user_pairs} usable {usable_users} item_pairs {item_pairs} usable {usable_items} slope_pairs {slope_pairs}",
    ]
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    item_indices := (0:<int(#data.items))
    training_genres := all_genres(data, item_indices)
    lines = ["genre_stats"]
    for genre := training_genres[]
        items := 0
        ratings := 0
        high := 0
        for: i < int(#data.items)
            if not contains_name(genres(data, i), genre)
                continue
            items += 1
            ratings += data.item_counts[i]
            for u := data.item_ratings[i][]
                if data.values[u][i] >= 4
                    high += 1
        lines = lines.append("genre {genre} items {items} ratings {ratings} high {high}")
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    lines = ["time_buckets {params.buckets}"]
    for: 1 <= int bucket <= params.buckets
        count := 0
        sum := 0
        users := [for u := data.users[] then false]
        for row := data.training[]
            int assigned := (row[3] - first_time) * params.buckets / (last_time - first_time + 1) + 1
            if assigned == bucket
                count += 1
                sum += row[2]
                users[row[0]] = true
        distinct_count := 0
        for present := users[]
            if present
                distinct_count += 1
        mean := if count > 0 then evaluation.as_real(sum) / evaluation.as_real(count) else 0.0
        lines = lines.append("bucket {bucket} ratings {count} users {distinct_count} mean " + real_text(mean, count > 0))
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    lines = ["rating_metrics"]
    real64[] test_rmse := []
    for: method < 7
        clipped_count := 0
        fallback := 0
        for prediction := tested.predictions[method][]
            if prediction.value < 1.0 or prediction.value > 5.0
                clipped_count += 1
            if prediction.fallback
                fallback += 1
        value := evaluation.rmse(tested.errors[method])
        test_rmse = test_rmse.append(value)
        lines = lines.append(names[method] + " rmse " + real_text(value) + " mae " + real_text(evaluation.mae(tested.errors[method])) + " clipped {clipped_count} fallback {fallback}")
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    real64 global_sum := 0.0
    for row := data.training[]
        real64 difference := evaluation.as_real(row[2]) - data.mean
        global_sum += difference * difference
    real64[] train := [evaluation.root(global_sum / evaluation.as_real(int(#data.training))), baseline.log[9], 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, svd.log[-1], als.log[-1]]
    lines = ["generalization"]
    generalization_methods := [0, 1, 5, 6]
    for method := generalization_methods[]
        lines = lines.append(names[method] + " train " + real_text(train[method]) + " test " + real_text(test_rmse[method]) + " gap " + real_text(test_rmse[method] - train[method]))
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    lines = ["neighborhoods k {params.k}"]
    neighbor_methods := [2, 3]
    for method := neighbor_methods[]
        with_neighbors := 0
        count_sum := 0
        real64 similarity_sum := 0.0
        for prediction := tested.predictions[method][]
            if not prediction.fallback
                with_neighbors += 1
                count_sum += prediction.count
                similarity_sum += prediction.similarity
        mean_count := if with_neighbors > 0 then evaluation.as_real(count_sum) / evaluation.as_real(with_neighbors) else 0.0
        mean_similarity := if with_neighbors > 0 then similarity_sum / evaluation.as_real(with_neighbors) else 0.0
        lines = lines.append(names[method] + " predictions {#data.testing} with_neighbors {with_neighbors} mean_neighbors " + real_text(mean_count, with_neighbors > 0) + " mean_similarity " + real_text(mean_similarity, with_neighbors > 0))
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    actual_sum := 0
    for row := data.testing[]
        actual_sum += row[2]
    actual_mean := evaluation.as_real(actual_sum) / evaluation.as_real(int(#data.testing))
    real64 actual_squares := 0.0
    actual_same := true
    for row := data.testing[]
        difference := evaluation.as_real(row[2]) - actual_mean
        actual_squares += difference * difference
        if row[2] != data.testing[0][2]
            actual_same = false
    lines = ["prediction_stats actual mean " + real_text(actual_mean) + " std " + real_text(evaluation.root(actual_squares / evaluation.as_real(int(#data.testing))))]
    for: method < 7
        real64 sum := 0.0
        for value := tested.clipped[method][]
            sum += value
        mean := sum / evaluation.as_real(int(#data.testing))
        real64 squares := 0.0
        real64 cross := 0.0
        all_same := true
        for: t < int(#data.testing)
            value := tested.clipped[method][t]
            squares += (value - mean) * (value - mean)
            cross += (value - mean) * (evaluation.as_real(data.testing[t][2]) - actual_mean)
            if value != tested.clipped[method][0]
                all_same = false
        defined := not all_same and not actual_same
        correlation := if defined then cross / evaluation.root(squares * actual_squares) else 0.0
        lines = lines.append(names[method] + " mean " + real_text(mean) + " std " + real_text(evaluation.root(squares / evaluation.as_real(int(#data.testing)))) + " correlation " + real_text(correlation, defined))
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    lines = ["error_bins edges 0.5 1.0 1.5 2.0"]
    real64[] edges := [0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0]
    for: method < 7
        bins := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
        for difference := tested.errors[method][]
            value := evaluation.absolute(difference)
            bin_index := 0
            for edge := edges[]
                if value >= edge
                    bin_index += 1
            bins[bin_index] += 1
        lines = lines.append(names[method] + " " + integers(bins))
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    lines = ["comparison"]
    for: a < 6
        for: a + 1 <= b < 7
            wins := 0
            ties := 0
            losses := 0
            for: t < int(#data.testing)
                first := evaluation.absolute(tested.errors[a][t])
                second := evaluation.absolute(tested.errors[b][t])
                if first < second
                    wins += 1
                elif first == second
                    ties += 1
                else
                    losses += 1
            lines = lines.append(names[a] + " " + names[b] + " wins {wins} ties {ties} losses {losses}")
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    for: variable < 2
        int[] bounds := if variable == 0 then params.user_groups else params.item_groups
        int[] counts := if variable == 0 then data.user_counts else data.item_counts
        label := if variable == 0 then "user" else "item"
        lines = [label + "_groups bounds " + integers(bounds)]
        for: group <= int(#bounds)
            int[] indices := []
            for: t < int(#data.testing)
                if group_number(counts[data.testing[t][variable]], bounds) == group
                    indices = indices.append(t)
            first := if group == 0 then 1 else bounds[group - 1]
            last := if group == int(#bounds) then "-" else "{bounds[group] - 1}"
            lines = lines.append("group {group + 1} from {first} to {last} pairs {#indices} " + error_fields(tested.errors, indices, false))
        sections = sections.append(lines)
    lines = ["by_rating"]
    for: 1 <= value <= 5
        int[] indices := []
        for: t < int(#data.testing)
            if data.testing[t][2] == value
                indices = indices.append(t)
        lines = lines.append("rating {value} pairs {#indices} " + error_fields(tested.errors, indices, true))
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    int[] test_items := [for row := data.testing[] then row[1]]
    test_genres := all_genres(data, test_items)
    lines = ["genres"]
    for genre := test_genres[]
        int[] indices := []
        for: t < int(#data.testing)
            if contains_name(genres(data, data.testing[t][1]), genre)
                indices = indices.append(t)
        lines = lines.append("genre {genre} pairs {#indices} " + error_fields(tested.errors, indices, false))
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    relevant_total := 0
    for u := tested.evaluated[]
        relevant_total += tested.relevant_counts[u]
    lines = ["ranking users {#tested.evaluated} relevant {relevant_total}"]
    for count := params.cutoffs[]
        lines = lines.append("cutoff {count}")
        for: method < 7
            hits := 0
            real64 recall := 0.0
            real64 ndcg := 0.0
            real64 ap := 0.0
            real64 rr := 0.0
            hit_users := 0
            for u := tested.evaluated[]
                metric := ranked_metrics(predictor, tested, u, method, count)
                hits += metric.hits
                recall += metric.recall
                ndcg += metric.ndcg
                ap += metric.ap
                rr += metric.rr
                if metric.hits > 0
                    hit_users += 1
            users := int(#tested.evaluated)
            lines = lines.append("  " + ranking_names[method] + " precision " + real_text(evaluation.as_real(hits) / evaluation.as_real(count * users)) + " recall " + real_text(recall / evaluation.as_real(users)) + " ndcg " + real_text(ndcg / evaluation.as_real(users)) + " map " + real_text(ap / evaluation.as_real(users)) + " mrr " + real_text(rr / evaluation.as_real(users)) + " hit_rate " + real_text(evaluation.as_real(hit_users) / evaluation.as_real(users)))
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    head := int(#data.items) / 5
    popular := [for i := data.items[] then false]
    for: index < head
        popular[predictor.popularity[index]] = true
    lines = ["beyond_accuracy top_n {params.top} head {head}"]
    for: method < 7
        coverage := [for i := data.items[] then false]
        diversity := 0
        real64 novelty := 0.0
        popularity := 0
        long_tail := 0
        real64 similarity := 0.0
        for u := tested.evaluated[]
            list := predictor.lists[u][method]
            string[] distinct_genres := []
            real64 nov := 0.0
            real64 pair_sum := 0.0
            for: int rank < params.top
                i := list[rank]
                coverage[i] = true
                for genre := genres(data, i)[]
                    if not contains_name(distinct_genres, genre)
                        distinct_genres = distinct_genres.append(genre)
                proportion := evaluation.as_real(int(#data.users)) / evaluation.as_real(data.item_counts[i])
                nov += evaluation.logarithm(proportion) / evaluation.logarithm(2.0)
                popularity += data.item_counts[i]
                if not popular[i]
                    long_tail += 1
            diversity += int(#distinct_genres)
            novelty += nov / evaluation.as_real(params.top)
            for: int a < params.top - 1
                for: a + 1 <= int b < params.top
                    value := neighbors.items[list[a]][list[b]]
                    pair_sum += if value == 2.0 then 0.0 else value
            int pairs := params.top * (params.top - 1) / 2
            similarity += pair_sum / evaluation.as_real(pairs)
        coverage_count := 0
        for present := coverage[]
            if present
                coverage_count += 1
        users := int(#tested.evaluated)
        lines = lines.append(ranking_names[method] + " coverage " + real_text(evaluation.as_real(coverage_count) / evaluation.as_real(int(#data.items))) + " diversity " + real_text(evaluation.as_real(diversity) / evaluation.as_real(users)) + " novelty " + real_text(novelty / evaluation.as_real(users)) + " popularity " + real_text(evaluation.as_real(popularity) / evaluation.as_real(params.top * users)) + " long_tail " + real_text(evaluation.as_real(long_tail) / evaluation.as_real(params.top * users)) + " similarity " + real_text(similarity / evaluation.as_real(users)))
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    lines = ["ranking_groups top_n {params.top} bounds " + integers(params.user_groups)]
    for: group <= int(#params.user_groups)

        for: method < 7

            for u := users[]
                metric := ranked_metrics(predictor, tested, u, method, params.top)
                sum += metric.ndcg
            mean := if #users > 0 then sum / evaluation.as_real(int(#users)) else 0.0
            fields = fields.append(ranking_names[method] + " " + real_text(mean, #users > 0))
        lines = lines.append(fields.join(" "))
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    lines = ["agreement top_n {params.top}"]
    for: a < 6
        for: a + 1 <= b < 7
            real64 total := 0.0
            for u := tested.evaluated[]
                first := predictor.lists[u][a][0:<params.top]
                second := predictor.lists[u][b][0:<params.top]
                intersection := 0
                for i := second[]
                    if contains(first, i)
                        intersection += 1
                total += evaluation.as_real(intersection) / evaluation.as_real(2 * params.top - intersection)
            lines = lines.append(ranking_names[a] + " " + ranking_names[b] + " jaccard " + real_text(total / evaluation.as_real(int(#tested.evaluated))))
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    lines = ["neighbor_grid"]
    best_k := [-1, -1]

                errors = errors.append(evaluation.clip(prediction.value) - evaluation.as_real(row[2]))
            value := evaluation.rmse(errors)
            fields = fields.append(names[method] + " " + real_text(value))
            if best_k[index] < 0 or value < best_error[index]
                best_error[index] = value
                best_k[index] = count
        lines = lines.append(fields.join(" "))
    lines = lines.append("best USER_KNN {best_k[0]} ITEM_KNN {best_k[1]}")
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    lines = ["biases"]
    kinds := ["item_high", "item_low", "user_high", "user_low"]
    for: kind < 4
        item := kind < 2
        int[] ids := if item then data.items else data.users
        biases := if item then baseline.items else baseline.users
        int[] counts := if item then data.item_counts else data.user_counts
        real64[] means := if item then data.item_means else data.user_means

            if item
                line += " " + title(data, id)
            lines = lines.append(line)
    sections = sections.append(lines)
    string[] output := []
    for: index < int(#sections)
        if index > 0

Preferences preferred_genres(factorization.ratings.Data data, int u, bool liked)
    all := all_genres(data, data.user_ratings[u])
    GenreCount[] ordered := []
    for genre := all[]
        count := 0
        for item := data.user_ratings[u][]
            int rating := data.values[u][item]
            if ((liked and rating >= 4) or (not liked and rating <= 2)) and contains_name(genres(data, item), genre)
                count += 1
        if count == 0
            continue
        item := GenreCount(genre, count)
        place := int(#ordered)
        for: index < int(#ordered)
            if count > ordered[index].count
                place = index
                break
        ordered = ordered[0:<place].append(item).concat(ordered[place:<int(#ordered)])
    limit := if #ordered < 3 then int(#ordered) else 3
    string[] names := []
    string[] fields := []
    for: index < limit
        item := ordered[index]
        names = names.append(item.name)
        fields = fields.append("{item.name} {item.count}")
    return Preferences(names, if #fields == 0 then "-" else fields.join(" "))

string[] recommendations_report(Predictor predictor, Testing tested)
    data := predictor.inputs[0]
    factorization.ratings.Params params := data.params
    baseline := predictor.baselines[0]
    neighbors := predictor.neighborhoods[0]
    ranking_names := rankings()
    string[] output := []
    for: request < int(#params.recommend_users)
        int id := params.recommend_users[request]
        int u := factorization.ratings.find_id(data.users, id)
        if request > 0
            output = output.append("")
        if u < 0
            output = output.concat(["user {id} unknown", "list POPULAR"])
            for: int rank < params.top
                output = output.append(popular_line(rank + 1, predictor.popularity[rank], data))
            continue
        output = output.append("user {id} ratings {data.user_counts[u]} mean " + real_text(data.user_means[u]) + " bias " + real_text(baseline.users[u]))
        liked := preferred_genres(data, u, true)
        disliked := preferred_genres(data, u, false)
        output = output.concat(["liked_genres " + liked.text, "disliked_genres " + disliked.text])
        int[][] recent := []
        for row := data.training[]
            if row[0] != u
                continue
            place := int(#recent)
            for: position < int(#recent)
                other := recent[position]
                if row[3] > other[3] or (row[3] == other[3] and row[1] < other[1])
                    place = position
                    break
            recent = recent[0:<place].append(row).concat(recent[place:<int(#recent)])
        fields := ["recent"]
        recent_count := if #recent < 3 then int(#recent) else 3
        for: rank < recent_count
            row := recent[rank]
            fields = fields.append("{data.items[row[1]]} {row[2]}")
        output = output.append(fields.join(" "))
        neighborhood.Candidate[] users := []
        for: v < int(#data.users)
            value := neighbors.users[u][v]
            if value != 2.0 and value > params.threshold
                users = users.append(neighborhood.Candidate(v, value, 0))
        for neighbor := neighborhood.select(users, params.list_size)[]
            int v := neighbor.index
            output = output.append("neighbor {data.users[v]} similarity " + real_text(neighbor.similarity) + " common {neighbors.user_common[u][v]}")
        for: t < int(#data.testing)
            int[] row := data.testing[t]
            if row[0] != u
                continue
            fields = ["heldout {data.items[row[1]]} actual {row[2]}"]
            for: method < 7
                fields = fields.append(real_text(tested.clipped[method][t]))
            output = output.append(fields.join(" "))
        for: method < 7
            list := predictor.lists[u][method]
            genre_match := 0
            for: int rank < params.top
                matched := false
                for genre := genres(data, list[rank])[]
                    if contains_name(liked.names, genre)
                        matched = true
                if matched
                    genre_match += 1
            output = output.append("list " + ranking_names[method] + " genre_match {genre_match}")
            for: int rank < params.top
                i := list[rank]
                if method == 0
                    output = output.append(popular_line(rank + 1, i, data))
                else
                    prediction := predictor.predict(method, u, i)
                    line := "  {rank + 1} {data.items[i]} " + real_text(prediction.value)
                    if method == 2 or method == 3
                        top := "-"
                        if prediction.top >= 0
                            int top_id := if method == 2 then data.users[prediction.top] else data.items[prediction.top]
                            top = "{top_id}"
                        line += " via {top}"
                    output = output.append(line + " " + title(data, i))
    return output

class Similar(int index, real64 value, int common, int difference)

Similar[] order_similar(Similar[] rows, int mode)
    Similar[] ordered := []
    for item := rows[]
        place := int(#ordered)
        for: position < int(#ordered)
            other := ordered[position]
            before := if mode == 1 then item.common > other.common else item.value > other.value
            if mode == 2 and item.value == other.value and item.common > other.common
                before = true
            if before
                place = position
                break
        ordered = ordered[0:<place].append(item).concat(ordered[place:<int(#ordered)])
    return ordered

string[] similar_items_report(Predictor predictor)
    data := predictor.inputs[0]
    factorization.ratings.Params params := data.params
    neighbors := predictor.neighborhoods[0]
    baseline := predictor.baselines[0]
    svd := predictor.svds[0]
    string[] output := []
    for: request < int(#params.similar_items)
        int id := params.similar_items[request]
        int i := factorization.ratings.find_id(data.items, id)
        if request > 0
            output = output.append("")
        string genre_text := data.catalog.genre_texts[data.item_catalog[i]]
        output = output.append("item {id} ratings {data.item_counts[i]} mean " + real_text(data.item_means[i]) + " bias " + real_text(baseline.items[i]) + " genres {genre_text} title " + title(data, i))
        Similar[] similarities := []
        Similar[] factors := []
        Similar[] common := []
        Similar[] slope := []
        for: j < int(#data.items)
            if j == i
                continue
            value := neighbors.items[i][j]
            if value != 2.0
                similarities = similarities.append(Similar(j, value, neighbors.common[i][j], 0))
            first := svd.items[i]
            second := svd.items[j]
            cosine := factorization.dot(first, second) / evaluation.root(factorization.dot(first, first) * factorization.dot(second, second))
            factors = factors.append(Similar(j, cosine, 0, 0))
            count := neighbors.common[i][j]
            if count >= 1
                common = common.append(Similar(j, 0.0, count, 0))
                difference := neighbors.difference[j][i]
                deviation := evaluation.as_real(difference) / evaluation.as_real(count + params.shrinkage)
                slope = slope.append(Similar(j, deviation, count, difference))
        similarities = order_similar(similarities, 0)
        factors = order_similar(factors, 0)
        common = order_similar(common, 1)
        slope = order_similar(slope, 2)
        output = output.append("cosine")
        int limit := if params.list_size < int(#similarities) then params.list_size else int(#similarities)
        for: rank < limit
            row := similarities[rank]
            output = output.append("  {rank + 1} {data.items[row.index]} similarity " + real_text(row.value) + " common {row.common} " + title(data, row.index))
        output = output.append("factors")
        limit = if params.list_size < int(#factors) then params.list_size else int(#factors)
        for: rank < limit
            row := factors[rank]
            output = output.append("  {rank + 1} {data.items[row.index]} similarity " + real_text(row.value) + " " + title(data, row.index))
        output = output.append("co_rated")
        limit = if params.list_size < int(#common) then params.list_size else int(#common)
        for: rank < limit
            row := common[rank]
            output = output.append("  {rank + 1} {data.items[row.index]} common {row.common} " + title(data, row.index))
        output = output.append("slope_one")
        limit = if params.list_size < int(#slope) then params.list_size else int(#slope)
        for: rank < limit
            row := slope[rank]
            output = output.append("  {rank + 1} {data.items[row.index]} difference {row.difference} common {row.common} " + title(data, row.index))
    return output

string[] training_log(Predictor predictor)
    baseline := predictor.baselines[0]
    svd := predictor.svds[0]

    names := ["BASELINE", "SVD", "ALS"]

void run()
    factorization.ratings.Data data := factorization.ratings.read_inputs()
    predictor := build_predictor(data)
    tested := test_predictions(predictor)
    users := tested.evaluated
    for id := data.params.recommend_users[]
        int u := factorization.ratings.find_id(data.users, id)
        if u >= 0 and not contains(users, u)
            users = users.append(u)
    for u := users[]
        for: method < 7
            ranked := .predictor.ranked(method, u)
    bool exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    report.save("predictions.csv", tested.csv)
    report.save("evaluation.txt", evaluation_report(predictor, tested))
    report.save("recommendations.txt", recommendations_report(predictor, tested))

    report.save("training_log.csv", training_log(predictor))

run()

import evaluation = "./evaluation.qui"

real64[][] real_matrix(int rows, int columns, real64 value)
    return [for row := (0:<rows)[] then [for column := (0:<columns)[] then value]]

int[][] int_matrix(int rows, int columns)
    return [for row := (0:<rows)[] then [for column := (0:<columns)[] then 0]]

class Result(real64[][] users, int[][] user_common, real64[][] items, int[][] common, int[][] difference)
class Candidate(int index, real64 similarity, int rating)

Result build(int[][] values, int[][] user_ratings, int[][] item_ratings, real64[] user_means, int shrinkage)
    user_count := int(#user_ratings)
    item_count := int(#item_ratings)
    users := real_matrix(user_count, user_count, 2.0)
    user_common := int_matrix(user_count, user_count)
    items := real_matrix(item_count, item_count, 2.0)
    common := int_matrix(item_count, item_count)
    difference := int_matrix(item_count, item_count)
    for: u < user_count - 1
        for: u + 1 <= v < user_count
            n := 0
            sx := 0
            sy := 0
            sxx := 0
            syy := 0
            sxy := 0
            for item := user_ratings[u][]
                other := values[v][item]
                if other == 0
                    continue
                value := values[u][item]
                n += 1
                sx += value
                sy += other
                sxx += value * value
                syy += other * other
                sxy += value * other
            if n < 2
                continue
            numerator := n * sxy - sx * sy
            dx := n * sxx - sx * sx
            dy := n * syy - sy * sy
            if dx == 0 or dy == 0
                continue
            scaled := numerator * n
            a := scaled * scaled
            b := dx * dy * (n + shrinkage) * (n + shrinkage)
            real64 sign := if numerator < 0 then -1.0 elif numerator > 0 then 1.0 else 0.0
            similarity := sign * evaluation.root(evaluation.as_real(a) / evaluation.as_real(b))
            users[u][v] = similarity
            users[v][u] = similarity
            user_common[u][v] = n
            user_common[v][u] = n
    for: i < item_count - 1
        for: i + 1 <= j < item_count
            n := 0
            delta := 0
            real64 numerator := 0.0
            real64 ni := 0.0
            real64 nj := 0.0
            for u := item_ratings[i][]
                other := values[u][j]
                if other == 0
                    continue
                n += 1
                delta += values[u][i] - other
                di := evaluation.as_real(values[u][i]) - user_means[u]
                dj := evaluation.as_real(other) - user_means[u]
                numerator += di * dj
                ni += di * di
                nj += dj * dj
            if n >= 1
                common[i][j] = n
                common[j][i] = n
                difference[i][j] = delta
                difference[j][i] = -delta
            if n >= 2 and ni != 0.0 and nj != 0.0
                similarity := numerator / evaluation.root(ni * nj) * evaluation.as_real(n) / evaluation.as_real(n + shrinkage)
                items[i][j] = similarity
                items[j][i] = similarity
    return Result(users, user_common, items, common, difference)

Candidate[] select(Candidate[] candidates, int count)
    Candidate[] ordered := []
    for item := candidates[]
        place := int(#ordered)
        for: index < int(#ordered)
            other := ordered[index]
            if item.similarity > other.similarity or (item.similarity == other.similarity and item.index < other.index)
                place = index
                break
        ordered = ordered[0:<place].append(item).concat(ordered[place:<int(#ordered)])
    limit := if count < int(#ordered) then count else int(#ordered)
    return ordered[0:<limit]

    int[][] result := []

Data read_inputs()
    raw := numeric_csv("input/ratings.csv")
    users := unique_sorted([for row := raw[] then row[0]])
    items := unique_sorted([for row := raw[] then row[1]])
    int[][] values := []
    for: u < int(#users)
        values = values.append([for i := items[] then 0])
    int[][] training := []
    total := 0
    for row := raw[]
        u := find_id(users, row[0])
        i := find_id(items, row[1])
        values[u][i] = row[2]
        training = training.append([u, i, row[2], row[3]])
        total += row[2]
    int[][] user_ratings := []
    int[][] item_ratings := []
    int[] user_counts := []
    int[] item_counts := []
    real64[] user_means := []
    real64[] item_means := []
    for: u < int(#users)
        int[] rated := []
        sum := 0
        for: i < int(#items)
            if values[u][i] > 0
                rated = rated.append(i)
                sum += values[u][i]
        user_ratings = user_ratings.append(rated)
        user_counts = user_counts.append(int(#rated))
        user_means = user_means.append(as_real(sum) / as_real(int(#rated)))
    for: i < int(#items)
        int[] rated := []
        sum := 0
        for: u < int(#users)
            if values[u][i] > 0
                rated = rated.append(u)
                sum += values[u][i]
        item_ratings = item_ratings.append(rated)
        item_counts = item_counts.append(int(#rated))
        item_means = item_means.append(as_real(sum) / as_real(int(#rated)))
    int[][] testing := []
    for row := numeric_csv("input/test.csv")[]
        testing = testing.append([find_id(users, row[0]), find_id(items, row[1]), row[2]])
    int[] catalog_ids := []
    string[] titles := []
    string[] genre_texts := []
    string[][] genres := []
    item_lines := lines("input/items.csv")
    for: 1 <= index < int(#item_lines)
        fields := item_lines[index].split(",")
        catalog_ids = catalog_ids.append(integer(fields[0]))
        titles = titles.append(fields[1])
        genre_texts = genre_texts.append(fields[2])
        genres = genres.append(fields[2].split("|"))
    item_catalog := [for item := items[] then find_id(catalog_ids, item)]
    catalog := Catalog(catalog_ids, titles, genre_texts, genres)
    return Data(users, items, training, testing, catalog, item_catalog, values, user_ratings, item_ratings, user_counts, item_counts, user_means, item_means, as_real(total) / as_real(int(#training)), read_params())

string real_text(real64 value, defined := true)
    if not defined
        return "-"
    result := "{value:.4}"
    return if result == "-0.0000" then "0.0000" else result
